agent-mcp-deployment-secrets.description: The live agent-mcp deployment secrets/provider keys currently supplied as ADHD_AGENT_* env vars (e.g. ADHD_AGENT_OPENAI_SECRET, ADHD_AGENT_ANTHROPIC_SECRET, ADHD_AGENT_DEEPSEEK_SECRET, ADHD_AGENT_DATABASE_PATH). The refactor MUST preserve these exact names via envPrefixOverride: ADHD_AGENT + per-field env overrides so no deployed secret silently stops resolving after cutover.
agent-mcp-deployment-secrets.how_to_provide: Confirm the deployed agent-mcp env var contract (ADHD_AGENT_* names — no _MCP_ segment, no namespace suffix) matches CURRENT_CONFIG_PATTERNS.md §agent-mcp 'Env vars used', and that adhd.environment.yaml sets envPrefixOverride: ADHD_AGENT with per-field env overrides reproducing every legacy name. Ensure the secrets are present in the deployment environment before agent-mcp cutover.

cargo-registry-token.description: crates.io API token consumed by the environment-core-rs nx-release-publish target (cargo publish --token $CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, defined in scaffold-workspace project.json). Needed only at release/publish time, not for cargo build/test — surfaced here so it lands on the Step 8 hand-off punch list.
cargo-registry-token.how_to_provide: crates.io -> Account Settings -> API Tokens -> New Token (publish scope for the adhd-environment crate); export CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN in the release environment.
